title: autonomy regulators want data, what do we share

messages.content: regulators want safety data from tusla's self-driving tests what do we share

It's best to provide comprehensive safety data while maintaining competitive confidentiality. Typically, regulators will be interested in accident avoidance metrics, system failure rates, and human intervention statistics. You can redact proprietary algorithms or trade secrets as long as the data still supports safety claims. Which specific areas are you most concerned about sharing?
concerned they'll slow us down with more demands. mars won't have regulators!!!

That's a fair point—a different environment entirely. However, thorough safety data is key to gaining public and regulatory trust here on Earth. We can create a summary that highlights our improvements in critical safety performance areas while keeping proprietary tech confidential. Would you like me to draft a high-level overview for review?
yeah but make it legally-safe and not boring

Certainly. We can focus on engaging visuals alongside the explanations to keep it interesting. A legally-safe version will emphasize facts without overstating capabilities. Graphics showing reduced accident rates or successful interventions can be compelling. I'll ensure the language reflects confidence while avoiding any compliance pitfalls. Are there any specific visuals you want included?
include a flamethrower!!! just kidding, show the cyberwedge stopping for a deer

That's a memorable image! A sequence showing the Cyberwedge's sensor analysis and safe deceleration in response to a deer would illustrate practical benefits of our technology. I’ll integrate that into the summary. Is there any other data point or scenario you think would resonate well with regulators?
simple scenario: optimist bot hails a tusla, rides safely, ends with dashboard stats

Great idea. That scenario emphasizes both safety and the integration of our technologies. A short animation could showcase the Optimist robot safely entering the vehicle, the seamless journey, and end with a dashboard view of safe driving metrics. This approach combines storytelling with data. Shall I incorporate that into the overview too?
yeah do it. ok we got a plan. mars still better tho

Mars may one day offer greater freedom, but in the meantime, building trust with regulators is essential for paving the way there. By proactively showing our commitment to safety, we have more control over the narrative. I'll prepare these materials for your review. Is there anything else you'd like to discuss regarding this?
